% A two-column document with lineno whose folder holds the .aux of a
% build with lineno 4.41, which wrote \@LN@col for each column of each
% page. lineno 5 no longer defines \@LN@col, so its 120 lines would give
% LaTeX's limit of 100 errors at \begin{document}. A build in a build
% folder does not read that .aux, and the page is written.
\documentclass[twocolumn]{article}
\usepackage{lineno}
\linenumbers
\begin{document}
\section{One}\label{sec:one}
Section~\ref{sec:two} follows.
\section{Two}\label{sec:two}
Text after section~\ref{sec:one}.
\end{document}
